_what: Files whose GENERIC credential-shaped assignment is a synthetic test fixture, with the reason for each.
_rules: An entry suppresses ONLY the generic assignment shape for the named path. It can never suppress a provider-issued shape (sk-ant-, AIza, ghp_) -- those fire everywhere, including here. An entry whose file no longer produces a generic match is STALE and FAILS the row, so a deleted or rewritten fixture takes its exemption with it instead of leaving an open door behind.
_not_a_substitute_for: 08-03's planted-secret control, which proves the scan catches a secret placed in a real file. This list only classifies what the scan already found.

allow.tests/integration/test_secret_channel.py: D-56 shared-secret guard test. The value is the xkcd passphrase 'correct-horse-battery-staple' -- a published example, never a credential. The file is also explicitly un-ignored at .gitignore:36 so it stays visible to this scan.
allow.tests/unit/test_secret_guard.py: Same D-56 guard, unit side; same published passphrase. Un-ignored at .gitignore:33.
allow.tests/unit/artifact_declaration_fixtures: Fixture for the rule-53 declaration artifact. The literal reads 'not-a-real-secret-only-a-fixture' and exists so a signature test has something to sign.
allow.tests/unit/test_handshake_step0_declarat: Step-0 handshake test. 'match-negotiated-secret' is the value both synthetic peers agree on so the digest comparison has two equal inputs.
allow.tests/unit/test_step0_sign.py: Step-0 signing test. 'a-shared-league-secret' is the HMAC key the test signs with; a real league secret is negotiated per opponent and never committed.
